entities.summary: Ernst Glaser was a German / Norwegian violinist, orchestra conductor and music teacher, married to the pianist Kari Aarvold Glaser. He was the father of the pianist Liv Glaser and the cellist Ernst Simon Glaser, both Norwegian classical musicians.
